title: NoteLama · Handwritten notebooks for tablets and phones
description: NoteLama is a notebook app for handwriting and scanned paper on iPad, Android tablets and phones. It works offline, without an account. In development.
heroLede: NoteLama is a notebook for handwritten ideas and the paper you want to keep. Write with a pen on iPad and Android tablets, read and edit on your phone. Everything works offline, without an account.
writeLede: A sketch of the tablet editor, built for this page. Write on the paper with a mouse, a finger or a pen. Switch pens in the dock, undo, redo, and scroll down to the next page.
paperLabel: Writable page. Draw with a mouse, finger or pen.
writeCaption: A sketch, not the app. Nothing you draw leaves this page. The small Lama in the top bar opens About.
writeNote: Paper and ink are content, so they keep their colors in dark appearance.
featuresLede: Everything below works on the device, without a connection.
fLibraryBody: Give each book a cover and its own paper. Sort, search, archive, and keep folders one level deep. Deleted books wait in the Trash for 30 days.
fPensBody: A steady pen, a pressure pen, a textured pencil and a highlighter. Save your favorite pens with their own color and width.
fPaperBody: Blank, ruled, squared, dotted or Cornell paper, in white or cream, A4 or Letter, portrait or landscape. Change it per page.
fZoomBody: Write large in a magnified area while small, neat lines appear on the page. It moves along the line as you go.
fSelectBody: Lasso handwriting to move, resize, rotate or recolor it. Draw clean lines, rectangles, ellipses and triangles.
fStickerBody: Place stickers from the built-in catalog or your own photos, then arrange them with your ink.
fUndoBody: Undo and redo follow your changes through the whole book, whichever page you are looking at.
fExportBody: Export pages or a whole book as a PDF. An editable backup keeps strokes, scans and paper, ready to import again.
fAccessBody: English and German, light and dark appearance, large text up to 200 % and full keyboard and screen reader labels.
libraryBody: Covers come in calm colors with a spine, so you find a book at a glance. Reopening a book takes you back to the page you left.
libraryTick1: Sort by recently opened, modified or title.
libraryTick2: The Trash keeps deleted books, with their pages, for 30 days.
emptyTitle: Your library is empty. Create your first book.
libraryNote: A model, not the app. Sort the books, or move one to the Trash from its menu.
studyBody: Lay tape over your own notes, then tap a strip in study mode to check what is underneath. Reveals reset when you close the book.
studyTick1: A PDF can keep the tape on, or show the answers.
studyTick2: Tape is a study aid, not a way to hide private content.
scanTitle: Paper belongs in the book, too
scanBody: Scan a handout or bring in a photo. NoteLama finds the edges, straightens the page and adds it to your book, ready for notes on top.
scanTick1: Move any corner by hand, rotate, or choose color or grayscale.
scanTick2: The scan stays as it was; your ink lies on top and can be erased.
storageTitleB: Your cloud, if you want one.
storageLede: Every finished stroke is saved on the device within a moment. Sync is optional and uses storage you already have. There is no NoteLama account and no NoteLama server.
fact1Body: Writing never waits for the network. If saving fails, NoteLama says so and keeps your work until it can save.
fact2Body: iCloud on Apple devices, Google Drive on Android, Nextcloud on both. You sign in to your provider, never to us.
fact3Body: When two devices changed the same book, both versions are kept for you to compare. No analytics, no tracking.
statusBody: NoteLama is in development and in testing on real tablets and phones. This page will link to the App Store and Google Play when it is ready.
appleBody: Apple Pencil on compatible iPads, finger writing everywhere. Optional sync with iCloud or Nextcloud.
androidBody: Active pens on supported tablets, finger writing everywhere. Optional sync with Google Drive or Nextcloud.
scriptNotice: JavaScript enables the language switch and the interactive models. The English page is readable without it.
footer: A notebook, wherever you need it. By Devmil Solutions.
noTracking: No analytics. No cookies. Your language choice stays in this browser.
movedToTrash: “{title}” is in the Trash for 30 days.
restored: The books are back in the library.
studyNote: A model, not the app. Tap a strip to reveal it.
scanFound: Edges found. Drag a corner, or focus it and use the arrow keys.
scanCrossed: The corners cross. Move a corner to continue.
scanAdded: The straightened page was added to the book, ready for notes.
providerNote_icloud: On iPad and iPhone, in your iCloud Drive.
providerNote_drive: On Android, in your Google Drive.
providerNote_nextcloud: Your own Nextcloud server, on both platforms.
aboutFamily: The Lama family: ProcessLama, GitLama, ShotLama, MailLama and NoteLama.
